releaseNotes:
1. Crossings Module (Left Drawer -> Crossings): Identifies, highlights, and maintains EHT transmission-line crossings across National Highways (NH), State Highways (SH), Main Rivers, and Railway Lines.
2. Verified Offline Crossing Datasets: Bundled OpenStreetMap Overpass (ODbL 1.0) vector geometries for the Cauvery Delta region (NH: 2,838 features, SH: 1,598 features, Main Rivers: 130 features, Railways: 728 features) for 100% offline detection and highlighting.
3. Spatial-Indexed Detection Engine: Uses actual feeder route geometry, ordered tower spans, background isolate processing, and configurable proximity tolerance (Potential Crossing vs Automatically Detected).
4. Crossings Abstract & Details Table: Category summary cards (Total Crossings, Unique Feeders, Unique Tower Locations), feeder filter dropdown, search, and tap-to-inspect details table.
5. Map Highlighting, Layer Manager & Manual Review: Distinct category icons/colors (NH=Red, SH=Green, River=Blue, Railway=Purple), independent Layer Manager switches, Show Feeder / View Tower popup actions, and full manual verification with SQLite audit history.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Responsive GIS Layer & Map Manager: Controlled state management ensures every overlay toggle switch (District Boundaries, District Names, Feeder Lines, Tower Markers, Fault Locations) and base map selector responds immediately to a single tap with >=48dp touch targets.
2. Base Map Switching Protection: Mutually exclusive base map selection with rapid-tap locking, stale-request cancellation, and a per-tile loading indicator for offline MBTiles initialization.
3. 60fps Map Pan/Zoom Optimization: Eliminated full-screen rebuilds on camera movement using scoped ValueNotifiers for HUD elements, cached tile providers, and O(1) independent overlay toggling.
4. GeoJSON & District Polygon Performance: Background-isolate GeoJSON parsing, Douglas-Peucker polygon simplification for rendering while preserving hit-test accuracy, and bounding-box pre-checks.
5. Zoom-Dependent Tower Labels: Automatic label visibility threshold at wide zoom levels to keep dense feeder and tower rendering smooth.
